sourceOfTruth: current main + exact-head PR/CI/Preview evidence + structured playtest feedback

northStar.target: one polished 10-15 minute battle with 2-4 regiments per side, roads, bridge/chokepoint, compact village, infantry, cavalry and artillery
northStar.playtestRule: run structured North Star playtest after material gameplay/renderer changes, at milestone RC, or after about five material player-facing merges; every FAIL becomes a replay/bug capture

featurePreservation.rule: previously working player-facing capabilities may not silently disappear, hide, disable or materially regress
featurePreservation.intentionalRetirementRule: requires explicit product decision, reason, replacement/migration or explicit retirement, updated tests/docs and Integrator approval
featurePreservation.postMergeCanary: after material merge verify new main workflow + core smoke before overlapping work

playability.evidence: core loop is automated, but a current structured 10-minute North Star playtest is not yet the release gate

movementFeel.evidence: player feedback identifies road/off-road and movement-to-contact feel as the main gap; deterministic #132 baseline is stale against current main and still needs interpretation

combatClarity.evidence: contact F state-handoff is the leading hypothesis; #129/#131 trace route remains unresolved

visualQuality.evidence: #136 Golden Battlefield is still draft/capture-stage and Pixi #133 has no KEEP/STOP decision

mobileUx.evidence: shared Pointer Events/mobile regression coverage exists, but current North Star mobile playtest/golden proof is incomplete

performance.evidence: 520-unit gate is established; renderer draw cost remains a known gap and GRAPHICS-V2 comparison is incomplete

audioFeel.evidence: no approved production audio slice yet

runtimeStability.evidence: current main 3faf912e completed workflow run 761 successfully; no current main blank/flicker/runtime blocker recorded

maintainability.evidence: authority contracts exist but stale/parallel PRs still need consolidation

featurePreservation.evidence: hard contract and machine-readable matrix are being introduced in PR #139; existing regression gates cover many capabilities but preservation impact was not previously mandatory

slots.observabilityTooling: free; PR #135 remains draft/paused and receives no active priority until explicitly claimed

experimentPolicy.featureFlagRule: risky renderer/AI/pathfinding/formation/telemetry paths remain opt-in until same-head CI + Preview + applicable visual/playtest + preservation evidence proves KEEP; obsolete flags are removed in cleanup

rendererDecision.evidence: exact head 896ddc6d is mergeable but GitHub workflow run 746 failed; visual and comparative performance evidence is not sufficient for KEEP
rendererDecision.rule: KEEP or STOP as soon as evidence is sufficient; existing renderer fallback is protected until KEEP is proven

artBible.goldenBattlefield: PR #136 draft capture-stage; must become approved desktop/mobile golden diff before merge

performanceBudget.knownGap: renderer cost remains material; compare frame/update/draw p95 and larger stress behaviour before renderer KEEP

telemetry.rule: no Production enablement; refresh from current main only if telemetry becomes a North Star quality priority

cleanupCadence.trigger: after about 8-10 successful feature/quality PRs, or sooner for clear duplicate authorities/flags/dependencies
cleanupCadence.scope: one small cleanup PR maximum; never displace an active blocker; preservation audit required before removal

locks.note: separate native prototype; browser North Star remains primary

locks.scope: movement-contact deterministic baseline/production movement task when claimed
